title: banco.lesson/1 and banco.lesson/2
description: The parsed body of a lesson (what lesson_revisions.body_json stores), by its schema member: $defs.body1 (sections, unchanged) or $defs.body2 (cards of blocks, D-245). The lesson.md front matter is $defs.front_matter (lesson/1) or $defs.front_matter2 (violations are E-SCHEMA with path /front_matter/...).

icon_name.description: One of our icon names (config/banco/icons.yml; E-LESSON-ICON in Ruby).

role_name.description: A colour role of the subject's palette (E-LESSON-ROLE in Ruby).

tag_name.description: A step tag of the subject (config/banco/lesson_palette.yml step_tags; E-LESSON-BLOCK in Ruby).

line.description: The line of lesson.md where the block or card starts (for findings).

goals_it.description: 1 to 3 lines of at most 12 words, each starting with a verb in bold (checked in Ruby).

book_it.description: At most 30 words; the fixed line is printed by our template.

hero.description: Optional: one diagram of the lesson's subject, drawn large on the cover (A1).

glossary.description: At most 12 terms; readability and the apparatus budget apply (1.11).

teaches_en.description: Target-language words the lesson teaches: outside the first 3000 words they are not W-LANG-LEVEL.

teaches_es.description: Target-language words the lesson teaches: outside the first 3000 words they are not W-LANG-LEVEL.

front_matter2.description: The front matter of a lesson.md with schema banco.lesson/2 (violations are E-SCHEMA with path /front_matter/...).

check_errors.description: Wrong answers that teach: one message per typical error (A9). Never served to the browser.

check_explain.description: Shown after a right answer or after the second wrong one. Never served up front.

input_before.description: Text or a formula before the answer box: '$x =$'.

profile.description: Passthrough to Grading::Spec (D-268). chem_formula is a W2-2 draft.

reuse_right.description: A classification: each category may be used by several items; drawn as rows of chips.

answer.description: A set of span ids; graded as a set.

check_span_select.description: check component span_select; the sentence and its spans are written in one language: text_it, text_en or text_es (D-292)

blank.description: A faded step: a check that gates the steps after it (A2, A9).

short_it.description: A short name of the card for the map and the Avanti button (2 to 3 words); the title when absent.

part.description: The n of the part this card belongs to (none for extra cards).

body1.description: The parsed body of a banco.lesson/1 lesson (unchanged).

goals_it.description: 1 to 3 lines of at most 12 words, each starting with a verb in bold (checked in Ruby).

book_it.description: At most 30 words; the fixed line is printed by our template.

hero.description: Optional: one diagram of the lesson's subject, drawn large on the cover (A1).

pages.description: Reserved for free pages (release 2): empty in release 1.

glossary.description: At most 12 terms; readability and the apparatus budget apply (1.11).

teaches_en.description: Target-language words the lesson teaches: outside the first 3000 words they are not W-LANG-LEVEL.

teaches_es.description: Target-language words the lesson teaches: outside the first 3000 words they are not W-LANG-LEVEL.

body2.description: The parsed body of a banco.lesson/2 lesson (what lesson_revisions.body_json stores): cards of typed blocks. Text fields hold the source markup, parsed again where drawn.

lang_text.description: Target-language text (a key ending in _en, _es or _la); at most 12 words in running sentences (E-READ target-language set).

target_id.description: A stored target id of a diagram's select set, as the type names it ('c1.nucleoid'); the student's page only ever sees tN.

short_id.description: An id inside a block (a speaker, a hotspot).

year.description: A year as an integer string; negative = a.C.; '0' does not exist.

verify.description: Truth at authoring time (D-268): Ruby calls the registered function and refuses the check (E-LESSON-VERIFY) when the answer, or the answer of a coded wrong answer, disagrees. Always dropped from the served body (L1).

reachable_ok.description: One Italian sentence saying why the figure's reachable values do not give the answer away (L5); shown to the reviewer and the teacher, never served.

listen.description: The text a listen check reads aloud, behind 'Mostra il testo' (A8): exactly one of text_en and text_es.

diagram.description: The check's own figure, of a type that declares target sets (x-banco-targets); drawn in mode select with neutral targets (L3).

check_select.description: check component select: tap zones of a drawing (WAVE2 2.11). pick one: any one member of answer is right; many: exactly the set answer.

check_tiles.description: check component tiles: build a sentence from tiles (WAVE2 2.11); distractors are the tiles outside the answer; graded as a sequence.

check_ordering.description: check component ordering: put items in order (WAVE2 2.11); graded as a sequence.

check_amount_words.description: check component amount_words: write an amount in words; NumWords builds the accepted forms and the typical wrong ones (W2-2 draft).

b_source.description: A source: a legal text with its plain version (W2-1), a historical source (W2-2 draft half). Counts as a visual (1.8). Every part's text is an exact substring of the imported reference (E-QUOTE-REF).

b_reveal.description: An ungraded reveal (WAVE2 2.10): a flip card with a question and its answer, or the crossroads with options. Served: teaching content (L8), read aloud only once shown (L10).

model_it.description: Withheld (L6): served only by the check endpoint after the outline is right or the second try.

b_oral.description: The oral rehearsal (WAVE2 2.10): a question, an outline to put in order (graded as an ordering), the connectives and terms to say, then the model answer. No microphone, nothing recorded.

b_dialogue.description: A scripted dialogue in the target language (WAVE2 2.6), every line with its Italian gloss one tap away. Counts as a visual in english and spanish lessons.

b_image.description: A licensed photo (WAVE2 2.7; the operator said yes on 2026-10-12): at most 2 per lesson, 300 KB. W2-2 draft: it needs the lesson_assets migration.

page.description: The key of a free page (SUBJECT.slug); the subject is the lesson's.

revision.description: A page revision id. `latest` is resolved to an integer at submit and stored as that integer, like a topic pin.

b_page.description: A free page (release 2, D-290): a sandboxed interactive scene on its own origin, embedded in an extra card beside a still visual. Served: the poster, the caption, the page's own texts and a button; the iframe loads only on a click. Never counted for a skill state.
